data.gender_notes: Ismael is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Ismael is recorded in name-lists as “God hears”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ismael expresses “God hears”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ismael total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Ισμαήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ισμαήλ προέρχεται από τα εβραϊκά και σημαίνει ο Θεός ακούει, και αναφέρεται στο πρόσωπο του Ισμαήλ, γιου του Αβραάμ, και είναι σημαντική μορφή στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη

in_latin.name: Ismael
in_latin.long_meaning: Ismael est nomen Hebraicum, compositum ex duobus partibus: Isma - Deus audiet, et El - Deus, quod significat preces patris ad Deum pro filio
